basics.name: Ricky Grassmuck
basics.label: DevOps Engineer
basics.summary: DevOps engineer with 9+ years of Linux experience, from Tier 2 support on live production servers to designing and operating highly available HashiCorp Vault, Consul, and Nomad platforms. Focused on infrastructure as code, CI/CD, and Go tooling for developers.

work.name: cPanel
work.position: DevOps Engineer II (promoted from DevOps Engineer, 2022)
highlights: Designed, deployed, and operated highly available Vault, Consul, and Nomad clusters on on-prem OpenStack, hosting 50+ internal production services
Core engineer on the team that planned and executed the migration of 1,000+ Product Development repositories from Bitbucket to self-hosted GitLab, and later to GitHub Enterprise
Re-architected GitLab CI pipelines as GitHub Actions workflows during the GitHub Enterprise migration
Built and maintained an automated, CI-driven VM image pipeline (Packer, Ansible, OpenStack) that produced cPanel-installed images for QA testing and Technical Support

Designed and built a Go image-build API that gave client applications a single interface for requesting builds and routed webhook integrations with other internal services. This decoupled clients from the build backend, so new backends could be developed and tested alongside production without client changes
Developed Go CLIs, service APIs, and CI/CD tooling used by product developers, with integrations into Vault, Consul, Nomad, and OpenStack
Served as the company-wide subject-matter expert for GitLab CI and GitHub Actions, supporting developers and leading workshops on pipeline design
work.summary: Built, deployed, and operated internal developer tooling and the platforms it ran on for cPanel's Product Development organization. Ran highly available HashiCorp Vault, Consul, and Nomad clusters on an on-prem OpenStack cloud, provisioned entirely as code with custom Terraform modules, Packer, and Ansible.

work.name: cPanel
highlights: Troubleshot live customer servers across the full hosting stack: Apache/LiteSpeed/Nginx and PHP, Exim/Dovecot mail, MySQL/MariaDB, and BIND/PowerDNS
Diagnosed OS-level performance, filesystem, and security issues, including investigating and remediating compromised servers
Wrote scripts to automate common diagnostics and fixes, reducing time spent on repetitive tickets
Reproduced product defects and escalated them to development with detailed bug reports
Mentored new analysts and wrote internal knowledge-base articles
work.summary: Provided Tier 2 technical support to cPanel & WHM customers, diagnosing and resolving issues directly on live production Linux servers.

work.name: UTMB
highlights: Provided first-line support for Epic EHR issues affecting clinical and hospital staff
Imaged, deployed, and repaired university-managed Windows, macOS, and Linux desktops and laptops
Diagnosed and resolved network and VPN connectivity issues for on-site and remote users
Configured and supported virtual machines (VirtualBox, Parallels, VMware) for faculty and research users
work.summary: Provided on-site and remote IT support for faculty, staff, clinical, and research users across UTMB's Galveston campus.
